label: R-act2, intensive esse: every pure perfection is a perfection of esse itself
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred: every pure perfection is a perfection of esse itself (PERFECTION_OF_BEING_2, IntensiveEsseFrame.OfEsse), so that subsistent esse includes it. It is c4fb87a6 with 'perfection of being' read in the intensive sense. q.4 a.1 ad 3 states the act thesis in two steps ('comparatur enim ad omnia ut actus ... unde ipsum esse est actualitas omnium rerum, et etiam ipsarum formarum'), and q.4 a.2 ad 3 applies it to life and wisdom. Reception of esse (R-act1) does not give it: the bridge from R-act1 to R-act2 is missing. Purity of life and wisdom is a stipulative classification (DEF-PURE-PERFECTION). Open.
